comment: Mistville catalog seed data (M3.1, extended in M5.1). Sources: the author's Mistville notes (effects/costs/uses) + the IDs the author recorded in play (design §5.3). Fixes to the notes: (1) Sleeping Spice is listed twice in the notes (#2/#31, costs 200/300 differ): merged, keeping #2, with a note; (2) the notes' #24 is misnamed Map: Mistville Trader: corrected to Map: Unknown Old Stuff by its effect and ID; (3) "Explorer"/Spoiled Sauce/Torn Map are in the ID records but not among the notes' 53 entries: added (effects to follow); (4) Food names follow the log (Alchemy Workshop Rainbow Candy; the notes name the workshop differently); (5) M5.1 (2026-10-06): added Explorer's Glasses and Brain in a Jar (with effects) and the Food Pink Walnut Kernel (starting uses to be measured), as told by the author, plus the 14 encounter-only Old Stuff from the category table ("Diviner"/"Banker"/"Cartographer"/First Bank's Shackles/Rusty Cranial Nail/Amnesia Patient's Key/Uncanny Tales: Secret/Uncanny Tales: Gaze/White Crow Bonsai/Black Crow Bonsai/Egg of the Deep Mist/Egg of the Shallow Mist/Resident's Old Bowl/Resident's Wooden Box, effects to follow). Encounter-only Old Stuff never shows up in pick-1-of-3 or Trader offers; the pick list leaves out anything marked source: encounter in synergy.json. Effect texts keep the notes' wording. Names are the English client's log names.
